title: NCAA: Red Lions dominate Blazers to clinch top seed, twice-to-beat edge
summary: San Beda University dominated College of Saint Benilde, 82-69, to secure a twice-to-beat edge in the quarterfinals of NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
